title: Safety of proton pump inhibitors based on a large, multi-year, randomized trial of patients receiving rivaroxaban or aspirin
authors: Moayyedi P, Eikelboom JW, Bosch J, Connolly SJ, Dyal L, Shestakovska O, et al.
population: Stable cardiovascular disease and peripheral artery disease in the COMPASS trial, 3 × 2 partial factorial with rivaroxaban 2.5 mg twice daily plus aspirin 100 mg, rivaroxaban 5 mg twice daily or aspirin 100 mg
funder: The funding statement of the article was not read because the publisher page could not be accessed; Europe PMC lists Bayer as grant agency. Registry NCT01776424: lead sponsor and responsible party Bayer; collaborators Population Health Research Institute and Janssen Research & Development. PubMed lists Bayer, Leverkusen, as the affiliation of two authors.
result: Pantoprazole 40 mg daily (n = 8791) against placebo (n = 8807): no statistically significant difference in pneumonia, Clostridium difficile infection, fractures, gastric atrophy, chronic kidney disease, diabetes, chronic obstructive lung disease, dementia, cardiovascular disease, cancer, hospitalisation or all-cause mortality, except enteric infections (1.4% against 1.0%; OR 1.33, 95% CI 1.01 to 1.75). C. difficile infection was about twice as common with pantoprazole, from 13 events in total.
